app.title: Still Places
ui.noXR: No VR headset detected — you can still sit on screen. Drag to look around.
ui.disclaimer: For relaxation and mindfulness practice. Not a medical treatment.
ui.hint.pause: Point at the Pause button below to pause
ui.pauseSign: Raise your palm to open the menu, then resume or end
ui.handHint: Look at your palm to open the menu
practice.breath.desc: Follow the light as it breathes.
cue.arrive: Find a comfortable way to sit. Let your hands rest.
cue.settle: Breathe with the light. In as it grows… out as it fades.
cue.anchor.breath: Let attention rest on the breath, wherever you feel it most.
cue.breath.pattern.relax: In for four, hold for seven, out for eight.
cue.breath.wander: If the mind has wandered, that's fine. Gently come back.
cue.breath.soften: Soften the shoulders. Soften the jaw.
cue.breath.return: Back to this breath. Just this one.
cue.breath.release: Let go of counting. Simply breathe.
cue.close.widen: Let attention widen. The whole body. The whole space around you.
cue.close.return: When you're ready, take a deeper breath and gently return.
hub.hint: Turn the dial, or raise your palm for the menu. Select a window to enter.
hub.hintDesktop: Drag the dial or use the arrow keys to turn. Click the front window to enter.
